chunks: ʿAlī narrated from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ruled concerning the fetus of the Hilāliyyah woman, when she was struck with a stone and miscarried what was in her womb dead, that there is upon him a ghurrah: a male slave or a female slave.

key_terms.الْحَجَرِ: the stone used in the assault
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family
key_terms.عَبْدًا أَوْ أَمَةً: a male slave or a female slave as the stated form of compensation
key_terms.غُرَّةً: a prescribed indemnity paid for the fetus
key_terms.قَضَى: issued a legal judgment or ruling

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم rule as compensation for causing a pregnant woman to miscarry a dead fetus?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding compensation for causing the death of a fetus through assault upon a pregnant woman. It establishes that a prescribed indemnity is due in such a case, showing the recognized legal value and protection of unborn life in Islamic jurisprudence.
